newsitem.title: UK: P&O FALLS AS LARGE SELLER EMERGES.
newsitem.headline: P&O FALLS AS LARGE SELLER EMERGES.

text.p: Shares in Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co Plc slipped on Tuesday as a big line of stock was sold in the market, dealers said.
P&O shares fell 7p to 625-1/2p by 0949 GMT in volume of 1.2 million shares.

Dealers said the selling of P&O shares could have been prompted by a report in the Independent newspaper which suggested the European Commission (EC) could delay their approval for P&O's planned cross-channel ferry merger with Swedish operator Stena Line AB.
The newspaper said P&O was unlikely to hear from the EC until next month and had no indications as to whether any conditions would be attached to the merger.
The report said P&O had originally hoped to receive regulatory approval by July this year.
